'''Qwallo Mode''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served in the [[New Jedi Order]] during the time following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. He was believed to have perished during a mission in [[42 ABY]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], he was seen alive by both [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] during their journey into the [[Maw Cluster/Legends|Maw Cluster]], where they saw him breathing in the vacuum of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], armed with a [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]].

The Skywalkers eventually found Mode in [[Sinkhole Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. Mode had become a [[Mind Walkers|Mind Walker]]&mdash;a member of a group of Force-sensitives living at Sinkhole Station that were known for their ability to separate their minds from their bodies in order to travel in a realm of the Force known as [[beyond shadows]]. The Skywalkers met him in the meditation chamber of the station, and he begged them to let him rest beyond shadows. They granted him his wish, allowing him to [[Death/Legends|die]].
